measure.measure_definition: Measured value: area under the rituximab serum concentration–time curve from 0 to 6 months (AUC0–6m); Participants; Serum rituximab concentrations quantified with a validated ELISA at Sanquin Diagnostic Services (range 0.005–500 mg/l). Empirical Bayes estimates of AUC0–6m obtained by nonlinear mixed-effects modelling (NONMEM V7.5), extending a population PK model for i.v. rituximab in RA with subcutaneous absorption bioavailability and rate constant; steady-state AUC between 6-month doses calculated as AUC = (DOSE × F)/CL.; AUC0–6m during the first 6 months after study rituximab administration. Primary non-inferiority comparison: s.c.:i.v. geometric mean ratio; non-inferiority margin 0.8; s.c. considered non-inferior if the lower boundary of the 90% CI of the ratio exceeds 0.8. AUC estimates are model-derived; trapezoidal AUC is a separate sensitivity analysis not included here.

Measured value: change in DAS28-CRP score from baseline to 6 months; Participants; DAS28-CRP assessed at baseline and 6 months (also 3 months). Change from baseline analyzed with ANCOVA with administration route as determinant, adjusted for stratum (previous rituximab dose) and baseline DAS28-CRP. Missing DAS28-CRP values imputed with multiple imputation.; Change from baseline to 6 months; negative values indicate a decrease in disease activity. Between-group comparison is s.c. versus i.v.; subtraction direction is not explicitly defined; non-inferiority margin 0.6; s.c. considered non-inferior if the 95% CI does not exceed 0.6. Remission defined as DAS28-CRP <2.4 and low disease activity as <2.9 for descriptive context.

Measured value: peripheral blood B-cell count; Measurements (per participant blood sample); Peripheral B cells measured by validated flow cytometric diagnostic assay at Radboudumc Haematology laboratory. Percentages and absolute number determined within 24 h after blood collection using CD45, CD3, CD19 and CD16/56 (Tetra 2 kit, Beckman Coulter) on an Aquios volumetric flow cytometer; calibrated with Aquios Immuno-Trol cells; external quality control via UK NEQAS Alternative Immunomonitoring Program.; B-cell counts at baseline, 3 months and 6 months. Missing B-cell measurements excluded: two at baseline (1 s.c., 1 i.v.) and four at 6 months (2 s.c., 2 i.v.). Between-group comparisons reported as P values; no numerical median values are labelled in the figure.
